{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the early 30-day horizon, showing significant undershoot that gradually converges to match true outcomes",
    "Sentiment positively biases forecasts upward when sentiment scores are above 0.5, with stronger effect in the first 10-day window",
    "Mean reversion bias in model forecasts causes excessive oscillation around historical means, especially when price volatility is high",
    "Sentiment momentum effect: sustained positive/negative sentiment (3+ consecutive bars) amplifies the forecast deviation from true outcomes",
    "Lag effect present where model forecasts fail to fully capture price inflection points, creating persistent directional misalignment",
    "Volatility-adjusted correction: periods of high price dispersion in history produce forecasts that are excessively compressed relative to true outcome dispersion",
    "Sentiment lag: model forecasts incorporate sentiment with a delay that causes temporary misalignment with price-responsive sentiment shifts" ]}
